answer: I did not submit a job. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit needs 30 qubits. The live architecture for garnet reports num_qubits = 20 (QB1 to QB20), and the docs list garnet as Crystal 20. The circuit cannot fit on garnet, so it would fail transpilation and could waste credits. Two options would work. One option is a GHZ circuit of 20 qubits or fewer on garnet. The other option is the 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits and costs 0.75 credits per second. I spent no credits.
